info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows businesses to update marketing details of customer surveys based on specific parameters. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can efficiently modify marketing strategies linked to customer feedback. Typical consumers include marketing teams and data analysts who leverage insights from customer surveys to enhance engagement efforts. This operation supports the dynamic nature of marketing by enabling rapid adjustments to strategies based on customer responses.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific customer survey. Provide the necessary fields in the request body to modify the survey attributes as required.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the specified customer survey identified by CUST-100045. The JSON payload should contain the fields that need to be modified along with their new values.

200.description: Request completed successfully, customer survey details updated.
